'''Yvonne Targis''' was the proprietor of the [[Transport Depot]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. She was a [[Near-Human]] with green [[Hair/Legends|hair]], yellow skin, and a nasty disposition. She worked for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], whose agents often used the Depot as a drop off point.<ref name="GG7" />
